name: Munder Difflin
summary: Desktop app that turns terminal coding CLIs into a coordinated office of AI agents running on your own machine.
description: Electron desktop app that wraps 12+ terminal agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Qwen, OpenCode, Crush …) as pseudo-terminal agents, visualized as avatars on a Pixi.js office floor. Agents get markdown memory with semantic recall, mailboxes, per-agent git worktrees, kanban tasks with dependencies and a human approval queue; Pro adds dictation, meeting transcription and an expanded sidebar.
contains: wraps 12+ agent CLIs: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Kimi, Gemini, Qwen, OpenCode, Crush, Pi, Copilot, Cursor
avatars on a Pixi.js office floor; envelopes fly between desks as agents message
markdown memory with semantic recall; per-agent git worktrees
GOD orchestrator with an approvals queue for spend, scope and destructive operations
kanban tasks with dependencies, built-in Monaco IDE, Slack/webhook intake, skills catalog
free open-source build; Pro annual plan $150 (purchasing-power adjusted)
